# Minerva Tools — Free Design Utilities

> A growing collection of free, focused design utilities for designers and developers. No sign-up required.

## Available Tools

### Color Palette Generator
- URL: /tools/palette
- Generate harmonious 5-color palettes using multiple harmony modes (random, analogous, complementary, triadic, split-complementary, monochromatic)
- Lock/unlock individual colors during regeneration
- Copy colors as HEX, RGB, or HSL
- Built-in WCAG contrast checker with pair-wise analysis
- Custom color input via HEX or color picker

### QR Code Generator
- URL: /tools/qr-code
- Create customizable QR codes for URLs, WiFi, and more
- Download as PNG or SVG

### Gradient Generator
- URL: /tools/gradient
- Build linear, radial, and conic CSS gradients with a visual editor
- Copy generated CSS code

### Contrast Checker
- URL: /tools/contrast
- Test WCAG AA & AAA color contrast compliance
- Real-time foreground/background preview

### Box Shadow Generator
- URL: /tools/box-shadow
- Design CSS box shadows with a visual multi-layer editor
- Add up to 8 shadow layers with full control over offset, blur, spread, color, opacity, and inset
- 8 built-in presets (Subtle, Elevated, Sharp, Dreamy, Neumorphic, Layered, Colorful, Deep)
- Copy generated CSS code

### Typography Scale
- URL: /tools/typography-scale
- Generate harmonious type scales with modular ratios (Minor Second through Golden Ratio)
- Live preview with 30+ Google Fonts (Sans Serif, Serif, Monospace, Display)
- Export as CSS custom properties or Tailwind config
- 4 presets: UI, Editorial, Marketing, Compact

### Favicon Generator
- URL: /tools/favicon
- Create favicons from images, text/letter, or emoji
- Three input modes: Image upload (PNG/SVG/JPG), Text/Letter (custom font + colors), Emoji picker
- Generates all required sizes: favicon.ico (16+32+48), favicon-16x16.png, favicon-32x32.png, apple-touch-icon (180×180), android-chrome (192×192, 512×512)
- Outputs ready-to-use site.webmanifest and HTML <head> snippet
- Controls for background color, border radius (0–50%), and padding (0–30%)
- Live preview grid showing all sizes
- Download individual files or complete ZIP package

### Font Pairing
- URL: /tools/font-pairing
- Discover beautiful font combinations with 30+ Google Fonts and custom uploads
- Preview in realistic layouts (hero, article, UI cards)
- 8 curated presets (Classic Editorial, Modern SaaS, etc.)
- Export as CSS custom properties or Tailwind config

### SVG to CSS Converter
- URL: /tools/svg-to-css
- Convert SVG markup to CSS background-image data URIs
- Paste SVG code or upload/drag-and-drop .svg files
- Minimal encoding (short) or full URI encoding (max compatibility)
- Live preview and one-click CSS copy

### Meta Tag Preview
- URL: /tools/meta-preview
- Preview how your page appears on Google search, Twitter/X cards, and Slack unfurls
- Enter title, description, URL, site name, and OG image
- Live previews for all three platforms in tabbed view
- Generates complete Open Graph and Twitter Card meta tags
- One-click copy of generated HTML meta tags
- Tips for optimal title length, description length, and image dimensions

### Spacing Calculator
- URL: /tools/spacing
- Generate consistent spacing scales for design systems
- Base unit input with linear (base × n) or geometric (base × ratio^n) progression
- Presets: Material Design (4px grid), Tailwind Default, Bootstrap, 8pt Grid, Golden Ratio, Major Third
- Visual bar and box previews for evaluating proportions
- Export as CSS custom properties or Tailwind config
- Toggle between px and rem output

### Color Blindness Simulator
- URL: /tools/color-blindness
- Simulate how designs appear to people with color vision deficiency
- Three modes: color swatches, image upload, and live website preview (iframe)
- 8 CVD types: Protanopia, Deuteranopia, Tritanopia, Achromatopsia, Protanomaly, Deuteranomaly, Tritanomaly
- Side-by-side comparison of normal vs. simulated vision
- Uses Brettel/Viénot color matrices and SVG filters
- Overview grid showing all CVD types at a glance

### Tailwind Color Finder
- URL: /tools/tailwind-color
- Find the nearest Tailwind CSS color class for any HEX or RGB color
- Top 5 matches with similarity percentage using perceptual color distance
- Copy class names as bg-, text-, or border- prefixes
- Batch mode: paste up to 20 colors and get all matches at once
- Full palette browser with all 22 hues × 11 shades (242 colors)
- Tailwind CSS v3 default palette

### Glassmorphism Generator
- URL: /tools/glassmorphism
- Create frosted-glass UI effects with CSS backdrop-filter
- Visual editor with sliders for blur, opacity, saturation, border, radius, and shadow
- 6 presets: Subtle, Frosted, Bold, Dark Glass, Colorful, Minimal
- Live preview against a vibrant gradient background with decorative shapes
- One-click CSS copy with backdrop-filter, -webkit-backdrop-filter, border, and box-shadow

### Neumorphism Generator
- URL: /tools/neumorphism
- Build soft raised and pressed neumorphic UI surfaces with live preview
- Controls for light direction, distance, blur, spread, intensity, radius, width, and height
- Separate color controls for background, surface, light shadow, and dark shadow
- Presets for quick starting points (Soft Card, Subtle, Pressed, Slate, Candy)
- One-click copy of clean, production-ready CSS

### Aspect Ratio Calculator
- URL: /tools/aspect-ratio
- Simplify width/height dimensions into reduced ratio form (e.g., 1920×1080 → 16:9)
- Calculate missing dimensions from known width or height while preserving ratio
- Presets for common formats (1:1, 4:3, 16:9, 21:9, 9:16, 4:5, 2:1)
- Decimal and inverse decimal ratio output
- One-click copy for ratio strings and CSS `aspect-ratio` snippet

### px ↔ rem Converter
- URL: /tools/px-rem
- Instantly convert between px and rem CSS units
- Configurable base font size (default 16px)
- Quick-reference table with 20 common px values and their rem equivalents
- Batch mode: convert up to 50 values at once (px→rem or rem→px)
- One-click copy for individual values or all results

### Lorem Ipsum Generator
- URL: /tools/lorem-ipsum
- Generate placeholder text with 6 fun styles: Classic, Hipster, Pirate, Corporate, Space, Foodie
- Output as paragraphs (1–10), sentences (1–30), or words (1–200)
- Real-time word and character count
- Regenerate for fresh variations
- One-click copy to clipboard

### Flexbox Generator
- URL: /tools/flexbox
- Visual Flexbox layout controls (direction, justify-content, align-items, wrapping, gap)
- Live preview canvas with adjustable item count
- One-click copy of generated CSS container rules

### Grid Generator
- URL: /tools/grid
- Build CSS Grid templates with column/row/gap controls
- Align-items and justify-items toggles with live preview
- Copy-ready CSS output for grid container setup

### Border Radius Generator
- URL: /tools/border-radius
- Independent corner controls for TL/TR/BR/BL radius values
- Presets for common and stylized corner shapes
- Live shape preview + one-click CSS copy

### Clamp Calculator
- URL: /tools/clamp-calculator
- Generate fluid CSS `clamp()` expressions from min/max values and viewport bounds
- Supports px or rem output modes
- Displays slope/intercept values used in the computed expression

### Image Color Picker
- URL: /tools/image-color-picker
- Upload images and click to sample exact pixel colors
- Automatic dominant palette extraction
- One-click HEX copy for sampled and extracted colors

### Color Converter
- URL: /tools/color-converter
- Real-time conversion between HEX, RGB, and HSL
- Synchronized editable fields with validation
- Color swatch preview + per-format copy actions

### SVG to PNG Converter
- URL: /tools/svg-to-png
- Convert pasted SVG markup or uploaded SVG files to PNG
- Custom output width and height controls
- Client-side conversion and direct PNG download

### SVG Blob & Pattern Generator
- URL: /tools/svg-blob-pattern
- Generate organic blob SVGs and repeating pattern SVGs
- Controls for points, variance, colors, tile size, gap, and shape
- Copy raw SVG or download generated asset file

### JSON Formatter & Validator
- URL: /tools/json-formatter
- Pretty-print JSON with 2-space or 4-space indentation
- Minify JSON output for compact transport
- Inline validation with parse error feedback

### Base64 Encoder/Decoder
- URL: /tools/base64
- Encode UTF-8 text to Base64
- Decode Base64 back to UTF-8 text
- Instant mode switch with copyable output

### URL Encoder/Decoder
- URL: /tools/url-encode
- Encode URL components for safe query/string transport
- Decode encoded URL content back to readable text
- Supports quick copy of transformed output

### UUID Generator
- URL: /tools/uuid
- Generate UUID v4 identifiers in bulk (up to 100 at once)
- Copy individual UUIDs or all generated UUIDs
- Instant regeneration for fresh ID sets

### Regex Tester & Replacer
- URL: /tools/regex-tester
- Test JavaScript regex patterns and flags with live validation
- Inspect match positions and captured groups
- Preview replacement output with support for $&, $1, and related replacement tokens

### JWT Decoder & Inspector
- URL: /tools/jwt-decoder
- Decode JWT header and payload sections client-side
- Inspect standard claims including exp, iat, and nbf with readable timestamps
- Copy decoded JSON for debugging auth integrations
- Note: decoding only; signature verification is not performed

### Hash Generator
- URL: /tools/hash-generator
- Generate MD5, SHA-1, SHA-256, and SHA-512 hashes from text input
- Output in both HEX and Base64 formats
- One-click copy for either output format

### Unix Timestamp Converter
- URL: /tools/unix-timestamp
- Convert epoch timestamps (seconds or milliseconds) to local, UTC, and ISO date-time
- Convert date-time input back to epoch seconds and milliseconds
- Quick copy for converted epoch values

### Cron Expression Builder
- URL: /tools/cron-builder
- Build and validate 5-field cron expressions
- Supports wildcard, ranges, lists, and step syntax
- Includes plain-language schedule summary
- Shows next upcoming run times in local and ISO format

## Technical Details
- All tools run client-side — no data is sent to servers
- Built with React, TypeScript, and Tailwind CSS
- Responsive design for desktop and mobile
